items.title: A Gentle Introduction to Logical English 2
items.blurb: Start here: a hands-on tutorial that builds small programs — a tea party, a flying dragon, a slice of British nationality law, a tea shop — teaching how to write, query, test and debug LE in the editor, then citations, views and a second engine.

items.title: LE Views: screens written in Logical English
